677:t_017:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's the $$トゥウィンクルプロジェクト$$'s '$$ライオン$$'!」

677:t_017:3.en:
$$シェリル$$
($$アルト$$... I'll send my feelings to you...)

677:t_017:4.en:
$$シェリル$$
(No, I won't send them just to you. I'll send them to everyone, to the $$バジュラ$$, to the galaxy...)

677:t_017:7.en:
$$アルト$$
($$シェリル$$... I can feel what you're feeling...)

677:t_017:8.en:
$$アルト$$
(You really were... the girl I met back then...)

677:t_018:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「This is...! It's a $$フォールドウェーブ$$!」

677:t_018:2.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Impossible! These readings are beyond our predictions!」

677:t_019:0.en:
$$クラン$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ are pulling back!」

677:t_019:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Those guys! Did they break free of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s control?!」

677:t_019:2.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「This is bad! Amplify the $$クィーン#vajra$$'s $$フォールドウェーブ$$!」

677:t_019:3.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「The adjustments will take a little time!」

677:t_019:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll take you down before then!」

677:t_019:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Let's do it, you dogs! Our target is the $$バトル・フロンティア$$ fused with the $$クィーン#vajra$$!」

677:t_019:7.en:
$$シェリル$$
(Take our feelings with you!)

677:t_019:8.en:
$$アルト$$
(I'm going! I'll carry your songs to the $$バジュラ$$ on these wings!)

677:t_020:0.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「The $$フォールドウェーブ$$ amplification system's adjustments are complete.」

677:t_020:1.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Good...! We'll call the $$バジュラ$$ forces back!」

677:t_021:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Aren't $$ランカ$$ and $$シェリル$$'s songs working?!」

677:t_021:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「They aren't! The $$フォールドウェーブ$$ from the $$バトル・フロンティア$$ is being amplified!」

677:t_021:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Singing isn't some special power! Everyone has feelings inside! You just have to let them out honestly!」

677:t_021:6.en:
$$葵$$
「I understand! We'll bring our feelings together too!」

677:t_021:7.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「$$ランカ$$! You take the lead!」

677:t_022:1.en:
$$レド$$
(But it doesn't feel bad... So this... is singing...)

677:t_022:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(Come to think of it... We all sang together like this during the $$破界事変$$ too...)

677:t_022:4.en:
$$タケル$$
(That was... yes, after the battle in Antarctica.)

677:t_022:5.en:
$$桂$$
(Our song crossed space and time back then and worked a miracle...)

677:t_022:6.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「This isn't right! We're detecting faint $$フォールドウェーブ$$s from every one of them!」

677:t_022:7.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「What's going on?! Have they all developed $$Ｖ型感染症$$?!」

677:t_022:10.en:
$$不動$$
「I am no one worth naming. But I will tell you this.」

677:t_022:11.en:
$$不動$$
「A song is more than air vibrating. A true song transcends time and space to stir every soul...」

677:t_022:12.en:
$$不動$$
「They are grasping the truth. With the power of life, they may even make space and time tremble.」

677:t_022:13.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「I detect a defold reaction! Someone is coming!」

677:t_023:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Are those $$バジュラ$$ free of their control?!」

677:t_023:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「I recognize them! They're the $$バジュラ$$ swarm from the $$再世戦争$$!」

677:t_024:0.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Why?! Why won't they obey the amplified $$フォールドウェーブ$$'s commands?!」

677:t_024:1.en:
$$不動$$
「$$アイモ$$ is a love song...」

677:t_024:2.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「What does that have to do with it?!」

677:t_024:4.en:
$$不動$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ you tried to control actually came to this world to meet those $$バジュラ$$.」

677:t_024:5.en:
$$不動$$
「They came to weave love across space and time.」

677:t_024:6.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Their songs... broke through the dimensional barrier and summoned the $$バジュラ$$'s mates, so...」

677:t_024:7.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「They follow their instinct to preserve their species and ignore our orders?!」

677:t_024:8.en:
$$不動$$
「This planet's $$バジュラ$$ must have been bewildered. They came to meet another swarm, only to find it living inside unknown life-forms.」

677:t_024:9.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「You mean $$シェリル・ノーム$$ and $$ランカ・リー$$?!」

677:t_024:10.en:
$$不動$$
「It was the same in the $$再世戦争$$. They attacked humans to save their mates, believing the girls' songs were cries for help.」

677:t_024:11.en:
$$不動$$
「But the girls' feelings finally reached the $$バジュラ$$, and even brought the two swarms together here in this world.」

677:t_024:13.en:
$$ランカ$$
(Thank you, $$アイ君$$... You helped us convey our feelings to the swarm too, didn't you?)

677:t_024:14.en:
$$ランカ$$
($$アルト$$ and the others will save your $$クィーン#vajra$$. So you can rest easy.)

677:t_025:0.en:
$$ランカ$$
(Take care, $$アイ君$$. I hope... we can meet again someday.)

677:t_025:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Captain! We have an incoming message from the $$マクロス７船団$$!」

677:t_025:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This is our chance! We'll strike the $$バトル・フロンティア$$!」

677:t_026:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「You dogs! We've got a good wave coming!」

677:t_027:0.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「This is bad! We can't use the amplification system anymore!」

677:t_027:1.en:
$$船団幹部$$
「Does that mean we can't call the $$バジュラ$$ swarm anymore?!」

677:t_027:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「We've received a message from Captain $$マクシミリアン$$ of the $$マクロス７船団$$! He entrusts you with command of every fleet's $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ in that world!」

677:t_027:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「It's a $$マクロス・クォーター$$ fleet... They are reassuring allies.」

677:t_027:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「He also says each fleet's regular forces are gathering at the galactic center!」
